summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called enlicitide decanoate in children and adolescents who have a genetic condition causing high cholesterol levels. The trial is currently in Phase 2/3 and aims to include 153 participants. Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC is sponsoring the study, which is Recruiting. Participants will receive either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real treatment.
